scope: 02_rules.md:Answered question OQ-17 — Dependency vulnerability and update policy

topics.topic: ProjectOverview schema and availability representation when project data is unavailable
questions: What is the exact ProjectOverview field shape when the post-guard Registry context read fails: is `project` optional, and is `project_availability` a required ViewAvailability field?
Does ProjectOverview have an optional project plus a required project_availability field, or must project always be present as its declared field list requires?

judgement.why: This is the same ProjectOverview field-shape and project-availability question already decided by P7, and the relevant texts have not changed.

precedent.topic: ProjectOverview schema and project availability representation when context lookup fails
quotes:
`ProjectOverview`: six pairs — project, budget, expenses, progress, payments,
photos — each a `ViewAvailability` and a value present only when available.

A21 (derived at read time, nothing persisted), A27 and Factory
`d2c4511ea119`: a part whose builder answers `ScopedNotFoundError` is
`not_configured`, a persistence or Registry failure `temporarily_unavailable`;
no zero is fabricated; viewer photos are client-visible only.
precedent.why: State 5 defines ProjectOverview as six availability/value pairs and converts a Registry context failure into temporary unavailability.

questions: Which exact versions of fastapi, pydantic, argon2-cffi and uvicorn must the deployment pin?

judgement.why: Exact deployment dependency pins are an operational deployment-note concern owned by the Factory deployment route, not a State 2 behavioural rule.

topics.topic: Global memory bound for viewer-entry rate limiter keys
questions: Is total limiter memory required to have a fixed bound across distinct client addresses, or is it only time-window-bounded with an unbounded number of keys?

quotes: Request bodies and binary responses are bounded by runtime settings before expensive work; viewer entry attempts are rate limited per client network address and route, with bounded memory and a concealed answer, the address read only from the connection, never from a forwarded header, cookie or secret.
judgement.why: The rule expressly requires bounded memory, so a merely time-windowed structure whose key count can grow without a fixed bound does not satisfy it.

topics.topic: HTTP response for malformed snapshot-publication requests
questions: What exact HTTP response is returned when snapshot request decoding fails?

judgement.why: This is the same malformed snapshot-request HTTP representation question already assigned by P1 to the State 6 API contract, with no relevant textual change.

precedent.topic: HTTP status and body for malformed snapshot-publication requests
quotes:
A body that lacks a required field or carries one of the wrong type is
refused by request decoding before the bearer credential is checked: it is
not an import attempt, gets no `import_id` and writes no record.
precedent.why: The HTTP status and response-body representation of request-decoding failures are State 6 API-contract details.

topics.topic: Password hash migration after hashing-profile changes
questions: After hashing parameters change, what happens when a user successfully authenticates with a hash created under the previous parameters?

judgement.why: This is the same successful-login password-rehash question already answered by P2 from the later operation's exhaustive write effects, with no relevant textual change.

quotes:
Writes one `StaffSession` and one `AuditRecord` per success; one
`AuditRecord` per rejection.
precedent.why: The later authentication operation exhaustively states that a successful login writes only a StaffSession and AuditRecord, so it does not replace the password hash.

questions: Must overall progress be quantized, and if so to what scale and at what point in the calculation?

judgement.why: This is the same overall-progress precision and quantization question already answered by P3 through the general derivation-boundary money rule, with no relevant textual change.

precedent.topic: Precision, rounding, and quantization of overall-progress quotients
quotes:
`Decimal`, 2 fraction digits, `ROUND_HALF_UP` at derivation boundaries;
  stored amounts are already 2-digit exact.
precedent.why: The general derivation-boundary rule requires the derived overall-progress Decimal to be quantized half-up to two fraction digits.
